issues.title: Specify sub-type by SIDC code
issues.body:
SERGE currently takes the SIDC ( Symbol IDentification Codes) coding from the platform-types data.

Here is an example of an SIDC code:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/221203148-62d7681e-73cc-4aab-a837-357e48221e11.png)

We're going to extend this, so that (optionally) the SIDC code can be specified via a per-asset attribute.

The optional attribute will be named "a_SIDC".

When provided, this icon will be used instead of the one specified in platform-types.   The a_SIDC attribute will not be shown in the "Attributes" column of the My Forces tab.

Here is the reference for the set of symbols in use: https://www.spatialillusions.com/milsymbol/docs/milsymbol-2525b-ch2.html

The values will not need to be provided directly to me, but will be included in the data dump.

* [ ] add a_SIDC to all platform types, as string
* [ ] hide a_SIDC from attribute renderer in planning assets
* [ ] when creating AssetRow, use a_SIDC (when present) instead of string from platform-type
* [ ] **Note:** perceivedType now needs to support this full list of types. That suggests these actually become platform-types. Try to avoid that.
